item.title: A multi-sensor approach to monitor trail-running impacts on soil
item.content:encoded:
Nature Reviews Earth & Environment, Published online: 18 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s43017-026-00865-0

Félicien Tenas explains how a combination of LiDAR, time-lapse imagery and soil moisture sensors are used to monitor soil geomorphology changes during trail running events.
item.dc:title: A multi-sensor approach to monitor trail-running impacts on soil
item.dc:creator: Félicien Tenas

item.title: The importance of deep time from Hutton to Earth system science
item.content:encoded:
Nature Reviews Earth & Environment, Published online: 18 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s43017-026-00853-4

Modern observations sample only a brief interval of Earth history, limiting tests of Earth system behaviour beyond present conditions. Integrating deep-time evidence with observations and Earth system model results can extend empirical testing across a much wider range of environmental conditions.
item.dc:title: The importance of deep time from Hutton to Earth system science
